anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning correctly.
Trading system shows zero total profit/loss and ROI, with no active trades, indicating potential inactivity or issues with strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent performance degradation.
Review and potentially restart AI components to ensure they are operational and generating insights.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are correctly set up and capable of executing trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any bottlenecks or resource-intensive processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting the platform's ability to process trades efficiently.

recommendations.action: Restart or troubleshoot the AI system to ensure it is functioning and contributing to trading decisions.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system is not generating learning cycles or opportunities, which may indicate it is not operational, potentially impacting trading performance.

recommendations.action: Review and test the active trading strategies to ensure they are configured correctly and capable of executing trades.
recommendations.rationale: The trading system is not showing any active trades or profit/loss, which may indicate issues with strategy execution or market conditions.
